visual_readiness.reviewer: Independent performance_critic; root; implementation-author package review disclosed separately
visual_readiness.scope: Bounded DEV11 pickup/achievement placement and audited dead base remnants; exact immutable candidate at mobile viewports.
visual_readiness.findings: Independent critic inspected all eight exact-package feedback originals and real-clock motion/expiry/activation evidence, with no blockers. Root inspected all eight source feedback images, three exact-package feedback images and four shop images. The disclosed implementation-author review examines 25 originals across feedback, hazard, commerce and Mac. All 14 exact QA jobs pass; raw-evidence re-verification matches the complete report.

limitations: DEV11 is a bounded playtest correction, not completed premium polish, final 1.0 or an overall 9/10 approval.
Stable minimum 50 FPS remains unmet in the previous DEV10 virtual-Mac sessions. DEV11 has no fresh sustained-performance or physical-iPhone certification.

All-tool motion quality, remaining wall/Bedrock joins and repeated terrain patterns remain open. The new Worn/right motion pilot is mechanically green but has a disclosed framing limitation; broader coverage is ongoing.
Camera V2 saved measured setup work but demonstrated no FPS gain. The compact Moss corner study visibly clipped opaque stone. Neither is adopted.
Mac WebKit uses actual darwin/WebKit26.5/Apple GPU at 1696x780. It is not a physical iPhone. Its non-portable extension warning is retained; no runtime/GL errors were found in the reviewed jobs.
Feedback GUI activation uses injected input and controlled camera placement with actual timers/drawing. Browser evidence includes the documented trusted and synthetic input mix.
Audio output was last checked in DEV10; audio source is unchanged. Earlier Linux WebKit failure evidence remains retained and was not relabelled as a pass.
The original player_visual.gd protected-baseline mismatch remains documented and unchanged.
